notes: Lifecycle states describe the maturity of Core data. They do not publish, unpublish or change current site behavior.

states.name: Draft
states.description: Use when an item is being drafted and must not be consumed by production surfaces.

states.name: Review
states.description: Use when an item is ready for technical, legal, editorial or source review.

states.name: Approved
states.description: Use when an item has passed review but is not yet the active version.

states.name: Active
states.description: Use when an item is the current approved version for future Core consumers.

states.name: Deprecated
states.description: Use when an item should no longer be used for new consumers but must remain available for compatibility and history.

states.name: Archived
states.description: Use when an item is historical and preserved for audit, comparison or legal history.

states.name: Future
states.description: Use when an item is reserved for a planned module, domain, engine or integration.

states.name: Cancelled
states.description: Use when an item was planned but should not proceed. Keep it for decision history when relevant.
